title: Dolgorae v0.1.4 closed successor identities

x-invariants: All source content is nonempty valid UTF-8 without NUL. Dependencies sort by unique UTF-8 alias; selected guidance preserves explicit order and unique aliases.
Core, common, Role, dependencies and guidance are joined with exactly two LF bytes. Accepted source ceiling excludes core/separators. Source order must exactly match the retained Role snapshot.
Protected interaction answers, their hashes, Controller secret bytes, expected revision and transport IDs are excluded. MCP requires trusted_invocation_ref supplied outside model arguments.

Only authoritative terminal acceptance creates this identity. References identify complete validated bytes; previews never substitute. Changes sort by path/old_path/kind; attachments sort by kind/identity.
Entries sort by unique UTF-8 entry_key. Complete encoded manifest is at most 1 MiB; accepted before any dispatch.
Sources sort by unique entry_key. Unknown/missing/failed sources remain coverage. No model call or free-text similarity establishes equivalence.
Receipt and lookup namespace, operation_ref, accepted_input_digest and accepted_subjects are exact equal retained facts; no reconstructed inputs or foreign subject substitution.
Receipt and lookup namespace, operation_ref, accepted_input_digest and accepted_subjects are exact equal retained facts; no reconstructed inputs or foreign subject substitution.

Authorized known subject identities are retained independently of a keyed operation reference. State-based mutations recover the same task/member/engagement/maintenance target without fabricating an idempotency key. Missing malformed mutation details remain Unknown under client policy.
Created by protected native hook before dispatch; not model-supplied. Opaque capability bytes are never present in this safe record. Missing/corrupt state cannot be recreated by delivery/lookup.

All fields are executor-accepted facts. rounds_used=accepted_assignments+unresolved_assignments≤caller_scope.max_rounds across the entire scope. Result and disposition facts must agree; disposition proof is acquired after final result under owning serialization. Primary semantic acceptance and Podway structural acceptance are separate.
k must not exceed accepted group size; timeout observes without cancellation.
conflict is true exactly when a key has multiple inequivalent variants. Equivalence compares every checked finding content field; provenance is never discarded.
Complete coverage accounts for every accepted group entry including failed, unknown and missing sources. Cursor is opaque; large bodies use complete artifact references.

The accepted task_body BytesRef binds complete JCS public StructuredTaskBody bytes, including ordered context, criteria and constraints. Accepted contexts match the complete public context references; merged_input binds the immutable merged findings. Normalization does not change task bytes or discard unknown fields.

x-digestEncoding: SHA256(UTF8(exact domain) || LF || RFC8785-JCS(closed object)); lowercase sha256: wire representation
x-invariants: Every listed digest field is required; null is explicit. Reject duplicate keys, lone surrogates, lexical floats, invalid UTF-8 and unknown fields. Integers are unsigned and at most 2^53-1. JSON Schema annotations require executor-side semantic verification. No schema declaration activates runtime support.
